Headline: #93 California/Dodge Temporary Reroute at California/Greenleaf
ShortDescription: 93 California/Dodge buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions, due to street blockage near California/Greenleaf.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#93 California/Dodge buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions via California, Lunt, Western, Touhy then resume normal route on California, due to street blockage near California/Greenleaf.

Allow extra travel time.
